CustomField.description: The word this program's books are labelled with on the errata form's Section picklist, when it is not the program code itself. RAIJ's books are labelled "Japanese" and RAI's "RAI Exam"; every other program matches on its own name and leaves this blank. Plain text, no JSON. Read by GARP_Portal_ErrataService, which falls back to its hard-coded overrides when this is blank.
CustomField.label: Errata Book Label
